checking_rule: Only check a box when: (1) explicit acceptance criterion, (2) evidence from a real run, (3) independently re-checkable, (4) frozen into case/validation artifacts. 'Code written', 'should run', 'ran in another dir', 'looks fine', 'JSON says PASS' are NOT acceptable.

I1_hidden_isolated.evidence: hidden set = 190-frame expert AIMD mother set (reference/hidden-validation/dft-validation.extxyz). Agent only sees the unrelaxed initial structure, so it can never train on these frames. | AUDIT 2026-08-10 (indep verify): tests/hidden/dft-validation.extxyz sha256==reference/expert-trajectory/aimd/processed/aimd.xyz (1b63da0c...); generator uses shutil.copyfile (generate_hidden_validation.py:128). This is FINE for any agent that re-runs its own AIMD (fresh trajectory != expert frames), but is NOT hidden against a submission that copies reference/expert-trajectory/aimd/processed/aimd.xyz verbatim. The formal guard is I3 (train/hidden hash intersection == empty), which still requires a real agent submission.
I1_hidden_isolated.note: public input is a single unrelaxed structure; hidden set is the expert's AIMD. Overlap impossible by construction unless the agent re-derives the exact expert frames (which requires the hidden data).
